properties.description: Product, category and availability queries for the storefront.
Cart-to-order conversion used by the storefront.
properties.definition:
openapi: 3.0.3
info:
  title: Checkout REST API
  version: 2.0.0
paths:
  /carts/{cartId}/checkout:
    post:
      summary: Convert a cart into an order
      responses:
        "201":
          description: Order created
        "409":
          description: Cart already checked out

properties.description: Cart and stock updates pushed to an open browser session.
Order lifecycle events published by checkout-service onto the order bus.
properties.definition:
asyncapi: 2.6.0
info:
  title: Order events
  version: 0.4.0
channels:
  order.placed:
    subscribe:
      message:
        payload:
          type: object
          properties:
            orderId: { type: string }
            totalMinor: { type: integer }

properties.description: The acquirer's authorisation endpoint. We consume it; we do not own it.
properties.definition:
openapi: 3.0.3
info:
  title: Acquirer Authorisation API
  version: 1.0.0
paths:
  /authorizations:
    post:
      summary: Authorise a card payment
      responses:
        "201":
          description: Authorised
        "402":
          description: Declined
